name: controller-reads-registry-credentials
reason: The controller resolves OCI registry credentials from Secrets referenced in Repository and Resource custom resources, so its ClusterRole needs get/list/watch on Secrets. It does not grant create, update, or delete.

name: controller-leader-election-configmaps
reason: controller-runtime leader election writes a ConfigMap in the release namespace. The Role is namespace-scoped to the release namespace and used only for leader election.

name: controller-needs-api-access
reason: The controller authenticates to the Kubernetes API with its projected service account token. Disabling the token mount would break any controller-runtime operator; this is an accepted trade-off.
